messages.author: 03da4563a4787ece
messages.subject: Grad Student Needs Work
parts:
Hi,
I am a Master's degree candidate in avian ecology with reasonable
statistical and computer skills. I have been watching several sites for
some time but have found very few job postings that are year round or
emphasize analytical skills. I have experience with normal and non-normal
distributions and a variety of statistical packages, though I have as yet no
experience with Distance Sampling. I have acted as Principal Investigator
on two projects, assisted on others and presented at several conferences.
I am perfectly happy to assist on ongoing projects. Ideally, I would prefer
to work near Boston, MA and to start in September, but I am willing to
relocate and am equally flexible as to start date. I can work at your site
or I can work from home where I have copies of several Statistics Packages.
I have an online resume and list of references available which I can send
you on request.

Thanks in advance for any help you can give. I would be interested in your
thoughts on this as well as in any leads you may have.

Eric Holt
e-mail: nfi...@massed.net
Note: As I share this e-mail address messages are listed as coming from N.
Fiske. They are however from me.
